root.label: Vals AI announces $40 million funding round

events.label: Vals AI announces $40 million funding round

slots.name: funding amount
slots.sentence: On Thursday, Vals is announcing a $40 million funding round at a $400 million valuation, Sri Muppidi is first to report.

slots.name: revenue growth
slots.sentence: The start-up said its revenue had increased eightfold this year, although it declined to share dollar amounts.

slots.name: benchmark announcement date
slots.sentence: Vals also announced a set of tests on Wednesday to measure A.I. models’ performance on child safety and mental health metrics.
